caption: The drawing features an object composed of two main brown shapes on a light beige background. The upper part is an irregular, oval-like form with a curved top edge and two lower extensions that curve downward and inward, resembling legs. The color of this upper shape is predominantly brown with lighter and darker patches suggesting some texture or pattern. The lower shape is a horizontally oriented, elongated oval with uneven edges, also in brown, and sits directly beneath the "legs" of the upper shape, connecting at two points. The entire composition appears centered on the page and consists only of these two brown shapes with no additional elements or background details.
title: Butter Molder
